verification.method: scripts/verify/kenya.py reads the original UN files directly (not the site's generated data) and compares them with the built page, JSON-LD and CSV; the build itself fails if any sentence-level claim (assertClaim) stops being true; then a hand read of title, description, headline, FAQ and story text.
what: Population 1950–2100, rank 2026/2050, share, growth, density, land area; third in Eastern Africa; about ten times 1950
Fertility 1966 peak, 1980, now; the 1980–2026 fall second only to Rwanda among African countries over 10 million; under 2.1 from 2066
Growth slower than Uganda and Tanzania; Uganda passes Kenya in 2046; net outflow every year since 2010
Peak 2098, slightly lower in 2100; 2050 total and rank; median age 2026/2050
Urban share 1950/2026/2050; title, meta description, headline, FAQ JSON-LD, CSV rows, live counter
against: UN WPP 2024 original file WPP2024_Demographic_Indicators_Medium.csv.gz (SHA-256 286ac36b…, downloaded 2026-11-25) and interim update zip (eb7846bf…) — 59 of 59 checks match
UN WUP 2025 original file WUP2025-F15-National-Definitions_percPop_by_category.xlsx (SHA-256 5fdc43a9…, downloaded 2026-11-25); licence CC BY 3.0 IGO stated in the file
